fields.body: Mitochondrion: double membrane, cristae, matrix, its own circular DNA. Plastids: chloroplast, chromoplast, leucoplast. Ribosome: no membrane, 70S in prokaryotes and in mitochondria, 80S in the eukaryotic cytosol. Golgi: cis and trans faces, the sorting station of the endomembrane system.

fields.body: Equations of uniformly accelerated motion: v = u + at, s = ut + at²/2, v² = u² + 2as. Slope of a position-time graph is velocity; slope of a velocity-time graph is acceleration; area under a velocity-time graph is displacement. Relative velocity: v(A rel B) = v(A) − v(B), signs are the whole problem.

fields.body: Mole = 6.022 × 10²³ particles. Check three things before substituting: which species the question counts, whether the volume is at STP, and whether the percentage given is by mass or by volume. Empirical formula comes from the simplest whole-number ratio; molecular formula needs the molar mass.
